recognize_zh: CD3 染色可見大量 T 細胞環狀聚集並侵入毛囊漏斗部上皮（亦即親毛囊性），毛囊周圍真皮也有密集 CD3 陽性浸潤，而表皮（右上）相對少見，這是親毛囊型蕈狀肉芽腫（folliculotropic MF）的線索。
features: Cross-sectioned hair follicles with central keratin/hair shaft surrounded by follicular epithelium
Dense ring-like infiltration of CD3+ lymphocytes within the outer follicular epithelium (folliculotropism)
Perifollicular and dermal CD3+ T-cell infiltrate, including a larger aggregate in the lower field
Relative sparing of the interfollicular epidermis (upper right) in this field
Positive cells show membranous staining; cytologic atypia is difficult to assess on IHC
describe_en: Skin biopsy stained for CD3 shows several hair follicle infundibula cut in cross section, with a dense, ring-like infiltrate of CD3-positive T cells permeating the follicular epithelium. A perifollicular and dermal CD3-positive infiltrate is also present, whereas the adjacent interfollicular epidermis shows relatively few intraepithelial T cells. No follicular mucinosis can be assessed on this immunostain. In the appropriate clinical and H&E context, findings are consistent with folliculotropic mycosis fungoides.

ddx.vs: Atypical T cells preferentially colonize the interfollicular epidermis (Pautrier microabscesses) rather than follicular epithelium with epidermal sparing.
Shows follicular mucin with a less dense, cytologically bland infiltrate and usually no clonal dominant T-cell population.
Contains mixed inflammation (neutrophils, eosinophils, B cells) and polyclonal T cells without prominent intrafollicular atypical T-cell colonization.

ddx.dx: Lymphocytic infiltrate of lupus or lichen planopilaris
ddx.vs: Show interface change at the follicle with basal vacuolization and perifollicular fibrosis rather than dense intraepithelial atypical T cells.
